Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?

Sent · Just now

Blundstone · AI says:

Our two most popular options are the Originals Series (500) and Classics Series (550).

Originals (500)

Snug, true‑to‑size fit with rounded toe
Unlined (cotton/cambrelle) for breathability
2.5 mm premium leather; durable all‑rounder for everyday and light outdoor use

Classics (550)

Roomier fit with extra toe height/width
Leather‑lined for added warmth and structure
More cushioned, molded footbed with XRD® in the heel and an extra set of insoles for fine‑tuning fit

Which is better for you?

Choose Originals if you want a traditional Blundstone feel: snugger fit, more breathable interior, and a versatile everyday/DIY boot.
Choose Classics if you have wider feet, wear boots for long hours, or prioritize warmth and underfoot cushioning; the extra insoles also help adjust sizing.

Both run generally true to size; go up half a size if you want more width. Classics and Kids styles include extra insoles to tweak fit.
